item.title: House votes down proposal to stock feminine hygiene products in school bathrooms
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — On Wednesday, the Wyoming House of Representatives defeated a bill that would have required public schools to provide feminine hygiene products in student restrooms, ending debate over whether access should remain through school nurses or be expanded to bathrooms statewide. item.title: Mills City Council moves to form appeals board for city
item.description: MILLS, Wyo. — On Tuesday, the Mills City Council voted unanimously to create a new appeals board to centralize the process for challenging administrative actions taken by the city.
